BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

2. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.

3. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

4. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.

7. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.

8. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

10. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.

11. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.

12. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Hand Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Plant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Site Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Appropriate Technology in Building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
